changeSet.sql:
create table analytics_classification_migration_run ( id uuid primary key, idempotency_key varchar(128) not null unique, status varchar(32) not null, batch_size int not null, cursor_position bigint not null default 0, total_items bigint not null default 0, applied_items bigint not null default 0, failed_items bigint not null default 0, requested_by varchar(128) not null, started_at timestamp not null, completed_at timestamp, paused_at timestamp, last_error varchar(2048) );
create table analytics_classification_migration_item ( id uuid primary key, run_id uuid not null references analytics_classification_migration_run(id), sequence_no bigint not null, entity_type varchar(32) not null, entity_id bigint not null, legacy_level varchar(32), decision varchar(32) not null, status varchar(32) not null default 'PENDING', snapshot_id varchar(64), snapshot_version bigint, effective_level varchar(32), error_message varchar(2048), applied_at timestamp, constraint uk_analytics_classification_migration_item unique (run_id, entity_type, entity_id), constraint uk_analytics_classification_migration_sequence unique (run_id, sequence_no) ); create index idx_analytics_classification_migration_batch on analytics_classification_migration_item(run_id, status, sequence_no);
